welcome.different.path.traditional: Traditional programs move linearly through the same sequence.
welcome.different.path.mindsprint: MindSprint adjusts difficulty dynamically to match learner readiness.

parentGuide.header.title: Parent Guide
parentGuide.header.subtitle: MindSprint overview, structure, and support strategies
parentGuide.section.overview.title: What is MindSprint?
parentGuide.section.overview.point1: MindSprint is a personalized math platform designed for steady, confidence-building growth.
parentGuide.section.overview.point2: It combines diagnostics, adaptive practice, MAP prep, and targeted support in one place.
parentGuide.section.diagnostic.title: Diagnostic Test
parentGuide.section.diagnostic.point1: A short, low-pressure diagnostic establishes a baseline before regular practice starts.
parentGuide.section.diagnostic.point2: Results identify strengths and gaps, then place each learner at a personalized starting level.
parentGuide.section.adaptive.title: Adaptive Practice Sheets
parentGuide.section.adaptive.point1: Practice sheets adapt after each session based on accuracy and confidence signals.
parentGuide.section.adaptive.point2: Difficulty increases gradually while weak skills are revisited for reinforcement and mastery.
parentGuide.section.mapPrep.title: MAP Prep
parentGuide.section.mapPrep.point1: Students receive RIT-aligned practice and MAP-style question exposure.
parentGuide.section.mapPrep.point2: Parents can use focused recommendations to prioritize high-impact topics.
parentGuide.section.skill.title: Skill Practice
parentGuide.section.skill.point1: Domain-based learning covers number sense, operations, fractions, geometry, and more.
parentGuide.section.skill.point2: Step-by-step support keeps challenge level appropriate and reduces frustration.
parentGuide.section.ai.title: AI Tutor
parentGuide.section.ai.point1: The AI tutor explains concepts, gives hints, and supports homework questions on demand.
parentGuide.section.ai.point2: Follow-up prompts can generate extra targeted questions for additional practice.
parentGuide.section.progress.title: Progress Tracking
parentGuide.section.progress.point1: Monitor accuracy trends, time-on-task, and difficulty progression over time.
parentGuide.section.progress.point2: Use mastery signals and growth indicators to guide weekly support at home.
parentGuide.section.different.title: How MindSprint Is Different
parentGuide.section.different.point1: Traditional worksheet programs use fixed sheets; MindSprint uses adaptive sheets that respond to performance.
parentGuide.section.different.point2: Traditional worksheet programs rely on manual checking; MindSprint provides instant feedback.
parentGuide.section.different.point3: Traditional worksheet programs progress linearly; MindSprint adjusts difficulty dynamically.
parentGuide.section.support.title: How Parents Can Support
parentGuide.section.support.point1: Encourage short daily sessions and review progress at least once a week.
parentGuide.section.support.point2: Celebrate small wins to build confidence, consistency, and long-term motivation.
